image_title: Tool Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
summary: This image presents a visual representation of the concept of T²RL (Tool Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning), illustrating the majority voting mechanism used to verify pseudo-labels. It includes a table showing sampled predictions (A, B, C), estimated rewards (0s and 1s), and verification results indicating skewed and reliable labels. The right side of the image features a bar chart comparing relative accuracy gains across various benchmarks, including MATH-1500, AMC, and AIME, with specific values noted for each method. The chart highlights the performance improvements of T²RL over traditional methods, emphasizing its role in stabilizing self-evolution in reinforcement learning. The image is sourced from a research paper authored by Ruotong Liao et al., dated March 2, 2026.
